name: Azeroth Companion
title: Stability Engine — Responsive Lists & Unified Navigation
features: Reduced redundant website work by using one central view-change notification for the homepage history, breadcrumb, desktop sidebar state and iPhone quick navigation.
Prevented reselecting an already-active studio from dispatching another activation or unnecessarily rebuilding expensive character and progress summaries.
Eliminated repeated recent-tool storage writes and homepage shortcut redraws when selecting a tool that's already the most recent destination.

Improved long collection-list responsiveness with feature-detected offscreen paint containment for planning checklists, Item Atlas, Progress Command, Character Dominion, Loot Hunter and guide cards, without hiding or discarding data.
Preserved the four-resource loading model, existing appearance, Secure My Azeroth verification, Cloudflare Worker, original studio controls and all browser-local character/item records.
Added desktop Chromium and phone-sized WebKit browser regression tests for single-event navigation, local preference write counts and 320 synthetic task-row scroll/interaction.
Maintained deterministic source-to-bundle integrity validation and published v4.9 cache-safe shell CSS/JavaScript bundles; existing unrelated core bundles remain unchanged.
